recommendation: Strengthen referral follow-up and outcome reporting, especially in Bungoma.
reason: Bungoma recorded the lowest referral completion rate and has many unknown outcomes.
suggested_action: Introduce referral registers, weekly follow-up reviews, and mandatory outcome updates.

recommendation: Use the refresher-training approach from the likely trained counties in counties with weaker danger-sign detection.
reason: Nyeri, Kilifi, and Kisumu show the clearest post-August improvement in detection.
suggested_action: Document the training package and use targeted coaching in lower-performing counties.

recommendation: Investigate the 505 malaria visits without a recorded RDT result.
reason: Missing RDT results reduce confidence in the malaria positivity indicator.
suggested_action: Make RDT result entry mandatory for malaria visits unless clinically not tested.

recommendation: Prepare for malaria workload increases around the peak months by reviewing supplies and CHV coverage.
reason: The monthly malaria pattern suggests that demand is not evenly distributed across the year.
suggested_action: Pre-position RDT kits, ACT supplies, and supervisory support before peak months.

recommendation: Review CHV workload allocation because visit volumes differ substantially across CHVs and CHUs.
reason: A small group of CHVs records very high visit volumes compared with others.
suggested_action: Compare workload, household assignment, geography, and reporting practices before taking performance action.
